messages:
maria gonzalez: Morning async — quick standup for eng-security (audits / IAM/KMS / PR pings). What I did / blockers / today
kevin lee: Did the key rotation dry-run in staging last night. KMS alias swap succeeded for two services. No traffic regressions.
priya rao: ✅ thanks. Can you add the post-rotation smoke test to the runbook?
kevin lee: Added steps and a `curl` check under the runbook. snippet: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $HEALTH_TOKEN" https://svc.internal/health | jq .status`
samir patel: SecBot ran the weekly scanner this morning — it posted a report. fyi there are 3 medium findings (outdated dependency) + 1 high in IAM policy for `redwood-deployer` role.
secbot: automated-scan: weekly-dependency-scan complete. Findings: DEP-1183 (medium), DEP-1187 (medium), DEP-1190 (medium), IAM-9001 (high). See: https://issues.redwood.internal/SEC-9001
maria gonzalez: @samir / @priya can one of you triage IAM-9001? Looks like an overly-broad `iam:PassRole` on the deployer role. If confirmed we should scope it to service accounts only.
priya rao: I'll pick it up. Blocker: need the list of services that rely on `PassRole` in prod to avoid breaking deploys. @kevin can you export last 30 days of role usage?
kevin lee: On it — will run `aws iam generate-service-last-used` + CloudTrail query and paste results here by EOD.
samir patel: For the dependency findings, I opened PRs to bump two libs. PRs: https://git.redwood/infra/dep-bumps/pull/48 and /49 — waiting on a quick CI run.
maria gonzalez: Nice. Reminder: compliance wants evidence of the KMS rotation schedule for Q2 audit. @ops-oncall can you attach the rotation calendar and the dry-run logs to the audit ticket? Ticket: https://compliance.redwood.internal/AUD-2026-07
ops-oncall: Will upload calendar + `kms rotate --dry-run` logs to AUD-2026-07 by noon PST.
kevin lee: One minor blocker from my end: terraform plan for `iam-deployer` in prod failed due to a drift in `kms_key_id` reference after the dry-run. Need a short window to reconcile.
priya rao: Can you run `terraform state replace-provider` and rerun `plan`? If you need help I can pair after lunch.
kevin lee: Yep, trying that now. If it still fails I'll tag infra on the PR.
maria gonzalez: Code review pings: please review PRs in `sec-config` — PR 212 (policy tightening) and PR 213 (logging retention change). Both are small.
samir patel: Reviewing PR 212 now. Left one comment about the `Condition` block.
priya rao: I'll take PR 213 after I finish IAM-9001 triage. ETA 2pm.
secbot: deploy-bot: noticed a canary rollback yesterday for `svc-ingest` — reason: OOM during peak. Logged under INC-3210. Not related to KMS work but flagging in case of correlated alerts.
maria gonzalez: Good catch. Noted. Today's plan: finish IAM triage (priya), reconcile terraform drift (kevin), attach audit evidence (ops-oncall), merge dep-bump PRs (samir).
kevin lee: FYI I'll schedule a 30-min maintenance window tonight at 22:00 UTC in case we need to finalize kms key id reconciliation. Will post channel notice before starting.
priya rao: If anyone hits a deploy failure related to `PassRole` I can temporarily add a scoped exception while we patch callers.
maria gonzalez: Thanks all — if anything pops up drop a short message here. :thumbsup:
kevin lee: quick question — do we want to rotate keys in prod monthly or align with quarterly compliance? I think monthly is safer but higher ops load.
priya rao: Let's keep quarterly for now; we can shorten to monthly after automation of cross-service smoke tests. Leave a note in the runbook to revisit after Q3 automation work.
maria gonzalez: Agreed. I'll add a follow-up ticket to track automation: SEC-TRK-204.
ops-oncall: Uploaded calendar + dry-run logs to AUD-2026-07. Also added the scheduled maintenance note for tonight.
priya rao: IAM-9001 triage: reproduced in staging — will open a scoped policy PR and list callers. PR soon.
kevin lee: Terraform plan succeeded after state reconcile. Pushing commit.
maria gonzalez: Closing loop — anything else?
samir patel: none from me.
priya rao: none.
kevin lee: none.
maria gonzalez: OK thanks team, end of async.
